newsitem.title: USA: Sun Intl unit makes tender offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: Sun Intl unit makes tender offer for notes.

text.p: An indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Sun International Hotels Ltd is offering to buy for cash two series of mortgage notes, the company said Friday.

Sun said Resorts International Hotel Financing Inc was offering to buy all of its outstanding $125 million principal amount of 11-percent mortgage notes due 2003 and $35 million principal amount of 11-3/8-percent junior mortgage notes due 2004.

It said Resorts would pay an amount "equal to an amount calculated in a manner intended to result in a yield to May 3, 1999, the first call date for the securities, equal to the sum of the comparable treasury yield and 100 basis points, plus accrued interest.

"At (February) 6, 1997, that price was 108.047 (percent) of the principal amount for the mortgage notes and 108.750 (percent) of the principal amount for the junior mortgage notes, in each case, plus accrued interest," it added.

Sun said it and Sun International North America Inc planned to issue about $200 million principal amount of subordinated debt securities in a private placement in order to enable Resorts International to do it. Sun International is a Delaware corporation and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sun.

The comparable treasury yield will be the yield on the 6-1/2-percent States Treasury Note due April 30, 1999 on February 20, 1997, it said, adding that its offer and consent solicitation will expire on March 10.
Sun International is a developer, owner and manager of resort and casino properties.
